Title: Public Preview: Azure Cosmos DB Fleet Analytics

Body.Content:
You can now unify insights across your entire Azure Cosmos DB footprint using Azure Cosmos DB Fleet Analytics, available in public preview. Fleet Analytics helps you manage data across multiple accounts, subscriptions, and workloads, providing large-scale, cross-account analytics for Azure Cosmos DB.  

 

You can analyze performance, usage, and billing trends in one place, so you can manage growth, optimize efficiency, and ensure consistency across your fleet. 

Learn more.
